Key Takeaways
Discussed app enhancements for dementia support, focusing on emotional, legal, and cognitive aspects.
Proposed additions include legal advice, financial services, and high-quality workout videos.
Plans to improve cognitive tools with new quizzes and worksheets.
Identified need to revise onboarding process and enhance UI for better text readability and navigation.

Customizations
Introduce a top-screen card
Streamline and customize the onboarding process and application features.
Increase font size for key categories.

Differentiate services according to stages of dementia, addressing varying needs.
Organize services into subcategories based on necessity, highlighting dementia-specific needs.
Proposed Solutions
Revise onboarding process
Update the onboarding flow with a new top screen card specifically for caregivers.
Revise app content to include guides on cognitive behavioral changes and personality shifts.
Emphasize the need for support groups and counseling for carers of individuals with dementia for emotional and practical support.
Highlight the necessity of respite care services like daycare to give carers essential breaks.
Discuss the importance of open conversations about end-of-life care preferences with dementia patients.
Advocate for legal and financial assistance to help with document signing and banking challenges faced by individuals with dementia.
Respond to feedback by incorporating videos for yoga and body workouts and modifying existing activities to increase engagement.
Integrate engagement tools such as quizzes, worksheets, and videos into the app for cognitive stimulation for dementia patients.
Design a worksheet for engaging activities
Product Feedback
Provide feedback on the presented updates.
Complaints
Address legal and financial matters early in dementia to prevent family and caregiver confusion.
Typically, only one or two sessions are needed for legal and financial advice.
Healthcare providers should approach end-of-life care discussions with patience and understanding.
Features Interested
Integrate high-quality workout and yoga videos
Develop reference videos emphasizing added value
Include printed worksheets in the kit
Pain Point
Individuals with dementia often face challenges in managing legal and financial matters, leading to potential loss of assets and vulnerability to exploitation.
Proper recorded videos are needed for body workout for yoga integration.
The project may be leading to a commercial activity, which could pose a problem that needs to be investigated.
